# Dial plans by country

In the Dial Plan table for some countries, the period denotes flexibility in number lengths within certain dial plans. For example, in the case of the dial plan entry '086xxxxxx.' the period signifies that the number sequence can vary in length, accommodating more than just a fixed set of digits.

Shared cost numbers cannot be provisioned with Cisco Calling Plans.

- [Africa](#africa)
- [Asia](#asia)
- [Australia](#australia)
- [North America](#north-america)
- [Europe](#europe)
- [Central America](#central-america)
- [South America](#south-america)

[Bahrain](#Bahrain)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

[India](#india)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

[Japan](#japan)

### Outbound calling plan

[Kuwait](#kuwait)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Qatar](#Qatar)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Thailand](#Thailand)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

[United Arab Emirates](#United-Arab-Emirates)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Australia](#australia)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Austria](#austria)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[France](#France)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Greece](#Greece)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Italy](#Italy)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Latvia](#Latvia)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Portugal](#Portugal)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[United Kingdom](#united-kingdom)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

[Brazil](#Brazil)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.

[Colombia](#Colombia)

### Dial plan design

When designing a dial plan, you must avoid any overlap between the internal dial plan and the national dial plan's digit maps (in the Outbound calling plan table below).

Webex Calling prioritizes routing internal dial plans over routing the national dial plan.

We strongly recommend that you use an outbound dial digit to route calls to the PSTN.

### Outbound calling permissions

Outbound calling permissions give you control over whether to allow or block users who try to dial particular call types.

Outbound calling permissions are country specific. They are based on the national dial plan in the the user's home site location.

You can block non-emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

You cannot block emergency calls with outbound calling permissions.

### About "designated numbers"

There are some designated numbers that you can't use in an internal (extension) dial plan: 

- All emergency call types are designated numbers.
- There may be other call types that are designated numbers.
- Designated numbers are always routed to the PSTN.
